text:
Priya: Heads up — finance-bot flagged ~USD 42k of untagged GPU spend in us-west2 for the current billing period. Looks like reserved usage ended up unattributed. Can infra help identify owners and whether reservations were incorrectly attached? cc @Mike @Anya :eyes:

billing-bot: [ALERT] High untagged compute spend detected for project group: render-services (us-west2). Potential reservation mismatch. Invoice IDs: INV-2026-03-1123, INV-2026-03-1145.

Mike: I can take a look. We rolled the nodepool-tagging rollout yesterday — there was a job that failed in the autoscaler hook. Possible that node metadata never got applied.

Anya: I saw a terraform apply from ci-service around 2026-02-18 that created a nodepool named "bench-renderer-rtx" without labels owner=team-render, sku=dedicated. Looking at the TF module it doesn't default those labels for nodepools created by the bench pipeline.

J. Gonzalez: If nodepools are created after reservations were purchased, GCP won't attach the reservation unless the quota/resource group/label matches the reservation -> that could cause the reservation to be unused and instances billed at on-demand. Matches the symptom.

Lena: Which reservations are we talking about? I can run a query against billing exports and reservation attachments to confirm coverage gap.

Priya: The invoice shows commit coverage dropped from expected ~80% to ~60% for us-west2 GPUs. Finance will demand a list of affected resources and a proposed chargeback by EOD.

Sam (Finance): Please produce a CSV with project, cluster, nodepool, instance count, usage hours, invoice_id and a suggested owner. If owner can't be found we'll tentatively put cost to platform-misalloc and backcharge once owner confirmed.

Anya: quick bq query I used to surface suspect rows: 
`SELECT invoice_id, project_id, labels, resource_name, usage_start, usage_end, cost FROM \`billing.raw.gcp_billing_export_v2\` WHERE region = 'us-west2' AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%' AND (labels.owner IS NULL OR labels.owner = '') AND usage_start BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-03-01'`

Lena: Running a targeted reservation coverage query now. sample: 
`SELECT reservation_name, attached_projects, SUM(usage_hours) as reserved_hours FROM billing.reservations WHERE region='us-west2' GROUP BY reservation_name, attached_projects;`

Priya: Finance will need the invoice IDs and ranges. billing-bot already listed two, might be more — include them in the CSV.

Mike: Proposed remediation plan:
1) Run a tag-sweep/backfill for nodes created in the affected window to add owner/sku labels and record evidence.
2) Where possible attach existing reservations to the correct project/labels (if GCP reservation allows attachment).
3) Patch TF module to always set owner and sku on nodepool resources created by CI pipelines.
4) Add an alert for reservation attachment fallthrough (delta between reserved hours and instance hours).

Command I'll run for backfill (dry run first):
```
# backfill labels for nodes created between ts1 and ts2
python infra/scripts/backfill_labels.py --region us-west2 --created-after 2026-02-10 --created-before 2026-02-20 --labels owner=team-render,sku=dedicated --dry-run
```

Anya: I'll open a PR to the TF module and gate the bench pipeline until we have labels enforced.

J. Gonzalez: Also check autoscaler init script — there is a race where kubelet metadata is overwritten by a cloud-init step and the reservation attachment tag isn't applied in time. Seen similar with preemptible churn.

Lena: I'm compiling the owner mapping now. I'll attach results to INFRA ticket once ready.

Sam (Finance): If remediation doesn't reconcile before next close we will allocate the provisional cost to platform-misalloc and then do a manual journal entry when owners are identified. Finance needs the ticket link and CSV for audit.

Mike: Created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-9876 and added initial notes + billing exports. Assigning tasks: Mike -> remediation, Anya -> TF patch, Lena -> owner list, Priya -> triage liaison with Finance.

billing-bot: Reminder: Billing adjustment requests must include invoice IDs, usage windows, and evidence (cluster logs or label backfill diffs). Use the Billing Adjustments form: https://redwood.internal/billing/adjustments

Priya: Timeline: please update INFRA-9876 with status by 17:00 PST today. Finance will hold provisional charge pending that update.

(2h later) Mike: Ran backfill in dry-run then live. Updated ~120 nodes with owner=team-render and sku=dedicated. Re-ran coverage query — provisional reserved coverage moved from 60% -> 77%. Still short ~4k USD. Open PR to attach reservations where policy allows.

Anya: TF module PR #412 ready for review, includes label enforcement and a post-create validation step to fail if owner label missing. :thumbsup:

Lena: Uploaded CSV to ticket with project/cluster/nodepool/invoice rows. Where owner couldn't be auto-determined, I set owner=platform-misalloc.

Sam (Finance): Got the CSV. We'll apply provisional charge to platform-misalloc this cycle and reconcile next month if owners are resolved. Please include the backfill diff in the ticket for audit.

Priya: Thanks everyone. Follow-up items: monitor commit coverage delta, add alert, bake label enforcement into CI. Closing loop in #eng-infra once billing adjustment submitted. :white_check_mark:
